## Change
Outcome, author and responsible workstream. Link an existing brief if used; do not repeat it.

## Evidence
Controlling source; affected areas and required reviewers; checks/results; open decisions; native/export consistency if applicable.

## Integration
- [ ] Current main incorporated and unrelated work preserved.
- [ ] Independent and affected-person reviews recorded; Janith coordinates merging.
- [ ] Applicable [merge checks](../00-control/templates/MERGE-CHECKLIST.md) complete.

A merge does not approve publication, quoting, legal use or onboarding.
